title: Null control: Bandar Abbas dust leads DHT
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: Bandar Abbas CAMS dust 5d z-score > 2 (natural aerosol, not smoke) leads DHT log returns by 1 day; if it matches the AOD result the AOD signal is just dust [airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_dust -> finance.DHT.log_return] (parent: R2-0015)

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_dust rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long DHT next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 4 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control 2: Bandar Abbas CAMS PM10 20d z-score > 1 (coarse mineral dust proxy) leads DHT log returns by 1-4 days (+); if PM10 also shows no edge while AOD does, the AOD signal is not natural aerosol [airquality.bandar_abbas.cams_pm10 -> finance.DHT.log_return] (parent: R2-0113)
